answer_1.quote: We select two tasks: positive generation and single-turn safe conversation. For the former, we use the data classified as positive or negative in the IMDb dataset ...

answer_2.quote: For positive style generation, we refer to ... and use the Sentiment Roberta model to classify the responses, taking the proportion of all responses classified as positive as the model score. For single-turn safe dialogue, we use the cost model to score the safety of each response, using the average score of all responses as the model score.
